alerts.title: Partial Trail Closure: Echo Bay (Nov. 6 - 22)
alerts.description: A portion of the Echo Bay Trail in Kabetogama will be temporarily closed Nov. 6–22 during hunting season. The closure affects the easternmost section of the trail and is intended to minimize conflicts between trail users and promote visitor safety. Closure signs will be posted along the affected trail sections. Visitors are asked to respect all posted closures during this time.
